programme.desc: Palattuaan Las Vegasiin kaverit ovat valmiita nappaamaan jättipotin. Kotikenttäedun turvin Chum hehkuttaa Vegasin oman herra Electricin hehkulampputemppua, kun taas Rick polvistuu kuningatar Elisabet II:n kruunajaisista peräisin olevalle jakkaralle.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Kaikkialla muinaisessa maailmassa on kuvauksia salaperäisistä hahmoista, jotka näyttävät olevan puoliksi ihmisiä ja puoliksi lintuja. Monissa kulttuureissa niitä kunnioitetaan jumalallisina olentoina, joilla on maagisia kykyjä.

programme.title: History's Greatest Warriors
programme.desc: Delta Force - joukot ovat vertaansa vailla terrorismin torjunnassa ja salaisissa operaatioissa. Se nousi esiin 1970-luvun lopulla vastauksena terrorismin kasvuun, ja sen jäsenet käyvät läpi tiukan koulutuksen tullakseen alansa asiantuntijoiksi.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Ancient Aliens kertoo kymmenestä kiehtovimmasta ja salaperäisimmästä symbolista ja koodista, jotka saattavat todistaa kontaktin muukalaisiin. Perun autiomaassa olevista glyfeistä aina kehittynyttä matematiikkaa sisältäviin spiraalimaisiin kivikuviin.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: Tony Harris kertoo UFO-erikoislähetyksessä viimeisimmistä tapahtumista ja vakuuttavimmista valokuvatodisteista UFO-paljastusten myrskyisänä vuonna. Ovatko viimeisimmät UFO-tapaukset uhka kansalliselle turvallisuudelle?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Rick ja Chum keräävät pisteitä testaamalla tavaraa flipperiparatiisissa. Corey satuloi toisen maailmansodan historiaa, ja Chum etsii harvinaista Sherlock Holmes - kirjasarjaa. Rick toivottaa Guns N' Roses - kitaristi ASHBAn tervetulleeksi viidakkoon.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Tuhansia vuosia sitten ihmiset kuvailivat kohtaamisia valtavien, ihmisen kaltaisten olentojen kanssa, ja jotkut arkeologit väittävät löytäneensä poikkeuksellisen suuria luurankoja. Voisiko olla, että legendojen jättiläiset olivat todella olemassa?

programme.title: CSI2* Santander - Highlights
programme.desc: The traditional International Showjumping of Santander is about to happen in the Palacio de la Magdalena. The finest riders on both the national and international scene will make an appearance at the Campa de la Magdalena to enjoy one of the most demanding events in Spain.Join their fight to determine the best rider on their category with a 1.40m class jump off, on Horse TV.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 3
programme.desc: This time, we go to the United Arab Emirates with showjumper Abdullah Mohammed Al Marri and meet the next generation of farriers training at Myerscough College in the north west of England. Moreover, we reflect on the 2018 Longines FEI Jumping World Cup Final with defending champion Beezie Madden and we visit Ireland's dressage star Judy Reynolds in Germany.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 4
programme.desc: In this month's episode, we go behind the scenes with Patrik Kittel at the FEI Dressage World Cup Final in Gothenburg and follow the action to find out who will become the champion the year. We will also meet some of the sport's top athletes who have their sights on lifting the Longines FEI Jumping World Cup trophy and catch up on all the vaulting action from the finals in Saumur, France.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - Episode 5 - Nations Cup Victoria Trophy
programme.desc: The equestrian instalations of Dehesa Montenmedio celebrate the Nations Cup. Among competition, the CSI2* Victoria Trophy with a maximum height of 1.45m offers winners the possibility to earn points in the Longines Ranking. This means all riders are eager to perform their best to reach the top in the Spanish facilities. Watch the best moments of the 2021 competition.

programme.title: Banorte Trophy - Highlights
programme.desc: The two-round challenge for the Banorte Trophy has 40 riders competing in this CSI5* test of the LGCT Mexico. With a height of 1.55m with a jump-off, this course designed by Javier Trenor has 13 obstacles and 16 jumps and will prove to be problematic for the riders who will have to speed up and offer a clear performance in order to win.Watch the highlights of the Banorte Trophy 2019 edition inside the LGCT.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 1 - Isabell Werth
programme.desc: One of the most successful dressage riders in history, Isabell Werth has already won 10 Olympic medals. She has won five team gold medals with the German team as well as the individual title in 1996. With a computer game in her name, she is a legend in the equestrian industry. Let's look back on her career that spans 30 years.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 2 - Peder Fredricson
programme.desc: In episode 2 we are focussing on one of the most revered names in the world of showjumping today, two-time Olympic silver medalist, Peder Fredricson. Born in Södertälje, Sweden, he has won two olympic silver medals: on in team jumping at the 2004 Athens Olympics and a second one in individual jumping at the 2016 Rio Olympics.

Will Ferne Park be able to change the turns of the competition and raise victorious in the competition?Watch the final between Ferne Park and Black Bears on Horse TV.

programme.title: FEI Ride Originals - Episode 10
programme.desc: Ride, an FEI Originals series, takes a deeper look into the equestrian world and focuses on lifestyle, horse culture and the fascinating bond between humans and horses both inside and outside the arena.

programme.title: FEI Awards 2021
programme.desc: More than 300 guests including equestrian legends, National Federations, FEI partners and stakeholders have attended the 13th FEI Awards. Equestrian commentator Steven Wilde has acted as the Master of Ceremonies of this international congregation of the equestrian community. The 2020 Award winners have also been present this year in Antwerp - Ingrid Klimke, Semmieke Rothenberger, Carmen Thiemman, Angelika Trabert, the Ebony Horse Club and more. However, in comparison with last year, this time stars of equestrian sports have been able to celebrate in person, bringing together the equine world to celebrate these achievements. This edition of the FEI Awards is more special as it is the FEI's centennial year and the nominees are of the greatest calibre. Find out how the FEI Awards 2021 went on HorseTV.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 3 - Igrid Klimke
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on one of the most iconic names in the equestrian world, German eventer Ingrid Klimke. With her horse Abraxxas, she won two gold medals in team eventing at the 2008 and 2012 Olympic Games. Despite never thinking she would have a career with horses, now she is an extremely successful rider.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 4 - Charlotte Dujardin
programme.desc: Charlotte Dujardin is a british dressage rider, equestrian and writer. She is probably the most successful British dressage rider in history, holder of three Dressage world records and winning major titles in international competitions with only 35 years. She is the Olympic dressage champion at London 2012 and Rio 2016. In this episode, we find out what drives her towards success.

programme.title: John Mayall - 70th Birthday Concert
programme.desc: Liverpools Kings Dock on July 19 2003 was the venue for a long awaited and much anticipated reunion between Eric Clapton and John Mayall And the Bluesbreakers. The occasion was both a celebration of John Mayalls 70th year and a fundraiser for Unicef. Also invited to the party were former Bluesbreaker and Rolling Stone Mick Taylor and veteran trombonist Chris Barber. If youre a lover of the blues it doesnt get much better than this. The show ran for around two and a half hours and the film is now presented here in its entirety for the first time.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of Rock N Roll Damnation and What's Next To The Moon and more.

programme.title: Guns N' Roses - Live From The O2 Arena London
programme.desc: Watch this mega-production of Guns N’ Roses performing live at the O2 Arena to its fans singing and vibrating to each song. Includes; Paradise City, Sweet Child O’ Mine, November Rain and many more.

programme.title: Snow Patrol - Live At Somerset House
programme.desc: With their third album, 'Final Straw', selling a cool 1.5 million in the UK in its year of release, Snow Patrol's reputation as a remarkable band remains intact. 'Live At Somerset House' reveals why the band is praised for delivering fantastic live performances. It also places them at one of London's most gorgeous settings which complements the band's distinctive and provocative sound perfectly. Performing live for the first time with a string section, this amazing Snow Patrol concert, features all the key hits including 'Run', 'Spitting Games', 'Chocolate' and a blistering version of 'Tiny Little Fractures'.

programme.title: Rihanna - Live at Made in America
programme.desc: Rihanna performs in Philadelphia in 2016, on the first day of the Made in America Festival. Rihanna was the main attraction of the festival, sampling from her Anti World Tour album as well as her older hits.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker - Live At Montreux 1990
programme.desc: The legendary bluesman John Lee Hooker brought his boogie style blend of rhythm And blues to deliver two blistering performances at the Montreux Jazz Festival in 1983 and 1990. Returning to the prestigious festival in 1990 with The Coast To Coast Blues Band the tracklist features hits such as ‘Boom Boom”, “The Healer” and his no.1 Jukebox hit “Boogie Chillen’”.

programme.title: Kylie Minogue - Live in London
programme.desc: Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. Filmed at Kylie's triumphant O2 Arena show in London, this concert film was produced using a lavishly hi-tech multi-camera shoot affording the viewer a spectacular experience from start to finish. The 2-hour show proved to be one of the most elaborate and extravagant productions ever staged by a pop performer, a multi-million dollar visual and musical feast, that delighted critics and fans alike wherever it played. Now Kylie's fans can re-live the experience with this amazing 2-hour document, which includes all of her best-known modern hits- Can t Get You Out Of My Head, Spinning Around- as well as her four Billboard Club smashes from 2010's acclaimed Aphrodite album including All The Lovers and Get Outta My Way.

programme.title: Charli XCX - Reading And Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of music festivals that take place annually in the cities of Reading and Leeds in England. Featuring Charli XCX.

programme.desc: Master of Puppets is the third studio album released by American thrash metal / heavy metal band Metallica, released March 3, 1986

programme.desc: Mixing classic RAndB vocals with a soulful blues-rock base, Alabama Shakes have taken garage rock and turned it on its head. Alabama Shakes takes the Austin City Limits stage for the second time in support of their newest album Sound And Color.

programme.title: The Lumineers - Live At Musilac 2017
programme.desc: The Lumineers bring energetic American folk-rock to the picturesque Musilac Festival. You won’t be able to resist clapping along and stomping your feet to the band’s raw sound and enchanting music.

programme.title: Elton John - Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Elton John featuring unforgettable version of his hits: Tiny Dancer, Rocket Man, Your Song and many more…

programme.title: Rush - The Rise Of Kings
programme.desc: From Rush's early days playing in the bars of Toronto to their epic success on American stages; tracing the band's journey through hard rock, progressive rock, and heavy metal in the 1970s.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone

programme.title: Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Eric Clapton And Steve Winwood - Live from MSG
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out three-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in late February 2008 when icons Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their all-too-brief days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969. Whether they will ever team again is unknown. But with Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood Live From Madison Square Garden fans everywhere are able to experience the sound and the glory of a performance on that famous stage by two of rock's greatest artists.

programme.title: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Peter Gabriel - New Blood: Live in London
programme.desc: Filmed at the Hammersmith Apollo in March 2011, New Blood - Live In London captures Peter Gabriel performing live with the 46 piece New Blood Orchestra. The repertoire mixes cover versions from his Scratch My Back album with classic tracks from across his solo career in brand new orchestral arrangements. Gabriel is a renowned live performer and his onstage charisma and instantly recognisable voice combine brilliantly with the orchestral sound palette to breathe a new sense of wonder into familiar songs. As you would expect the concert is also a visual feast, with graphics, animation and imagery blending to enhance and illustrate the music. This is truly a live experience not to be missed.

programme.desc: Watch AC/DC members deliver their signature high-voltage sound in this live performance.

After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle.

programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.desc: The FutureSex/LoveSounds album, which spawned the tour, is one of the most awarded 2007 albums and has sold eight million copies worldwide.Sexyback, What Comes Around...Goes Around, My Love, Summer Love are some of the highlights and were among the most played of the year around the world.

programme.title: Fall Out Boy - Boys of Zummer: Live In Chicago
programme.desc: Join multi-platinum band Fall Out Boy as they travel back to their hometown of Chicago for a mind-blowing audio-visual extravaganza. Featuring their newest hits Centuries, Irresistible and Uma Thurman, this 17 song concert also includes the band’s best loved songs from across their whole career. This special performance is one of the most memorable Fall Out Boy concerts ever, filmed during the Boys of Zummer tour that hit 39 North American cities throughout 2015.

programme.title: Robbie Williams - Live at the Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: A brand new show that brings a veteran artist at his best! The talented artist, who became famous in the group Take That, lacks presentations, but he himself begins his show by saying: Let me resubmit .... Robbie Williams has the ability to reinvent himself, exhibiting so much energy that he seems to be a rookie artist. Already in the 40s band of pop music, Robbie is more than an artist consecrated worldwide, is a reference with hits present in the best lists of consecrated DJs. This show at the Roundhouse coincided with the announcement of their 11th solo album, Heavy Entertainment Show, just released. The new album's title reflects Williams' performance as energy-dense as his 11-member big band, including his hits partner Guy Chambers on the piano. A formidable 90 minute pop odyssey. Mixing tracks from his Take That era, old or new, his songs allow him to reclaim his throne from an artist who dominates the stage - in fact, there is no one in pop music who combines his monumental energy with music Touching. A magical moment can be perceived in A Better Man, only with the guitar on stage; Proof that he is an artist that goes beyond the scenery.

programme.title: James Morrison - T In The Park
programme.desc: T in the Park festival is a major Scottish music festival that has been held almost annually since 1994 (the event did not take place in 2017). It is named after its main sponsor, the brewing company Tennents.

programme.title: Slipknot - Day of the Gusano
programme.desc: After more than a decade of patiently waiting, the Mexican Maggots finally welcome the most anticipated visit of Slipknot and Knotfest to Mexico. On December 8th, 2015, Knotfest took over Mexico City for the experience of a lifetime. The most passionate, powerful, dedicated and loud Maggots on Earth attended in hordes to witness in action their most inspirational figures: the 9 members of Slipknot. The band did not disappoint. This show will leave you speechless and craving more. The intensity of Slipknot and the love they have for their fans is palpable. The wait was well worth it.

programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007

programme.title: Tom Petty And The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.title: Strat Pack - 50 Years of the Fender Stratocaster
programme.desc: In 1954, Leo Fender gave the electric guitar a new sound and look that fully set it apart from its acoustic counterpart with the invention of the Fender Stratocaster, a solid-body electric axe with a revolutionary three-way pickup system and a modern, streamlined design that was like nothing else on the market at the time. Early rock 'n' rollers such as Buddy Holly and Dick Dale quickly embraced the Stratocaster, and since then it has become the guitar of choice for legendary players such as Jimi Hendrix, Eric Clapton, Stevie Ray Vaughan, Keith Richards, Bonnie Raitt, Mark Knopfler, and dozens of others. The Strat Pack: Live in Concert documents a special concert held at London's Wembley Arena in the fall of 2004, in which a stellar lineup of great rock guitarists came out to say Happy 50th Birthday to the Stratocaster. Performers include Joe Walsh, Ron Wood, David Gilmour, Brian May, Albert Lee, Hank Marvin, and many more.

programme.title: Bastille - Reading and Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of annual music festivals that take place in Reading and Leeds, England. The events both happen on the bank holiday weekend in August (on Friday, Saturday, Sunday), and share the same bill (occasionally with one or two exceptions). The festival's origins date to the Beaulieu Jazz Festival (1956–1961) which became the National Jazz Festival in 1961 (The National Jazz and Blues Festival in 1963) and settled in Reading in 1971. In 1999 a second leg was added at Leeds. Featuring : Bastille.

programme.title: a-ha - Unplugged: Summer Solstice

programme.title: The Chosen Unveiled - Fördjupning: På denna klippa
programme.desc: Efter att ha fungerat som rådgivare till TV-serien The Chosen, utforskar den messianske rabbinen Jason Sobel olika teman och idéer bakom den framgångsrika serien. Ur både ett bibliskt och judiskt perspektiv lyfts dessa bitar fram på ett sätt som gör både serien och Bibeln mer levande för oss.

programme.title: Ett Heligt Prästerskap Del 9
programme.desc: Cherstin och Esther samtalar om vikten av att välja välsignelsen.Ett Heligt Prästerskap är programserien som ger oss bibliska tips på hur vi kan leva ett radikalt Jesusliv. I denna programserie pratar vi om många olika saker men kommer hela tiden tillbaka till vikten av att läsa Bibeln och att göra aktiva val på livets alla områden. Detta för att kunna leva helöverlåtna liv enligt den plan som Gud har för sin skapelse. programme.title: BibelPodden - Fallet med den tomma graven
programme.desc: I Bibelpodden dyker Jonas Bergsten, Jonas Dagson, Malin Davidsson och Per Ewert med gäster ner i intressanta spår i världens mest inflytelserika bok. Bibelpodden är ett samarbete mellan Claphaminstitutet och Kristen Media Sverige.Påskens budskap om Jesu uppståndelse är grunden till den kristna tron och historiens största folkrörelse. Hur trovärdiga är Nya testamentets berättelser? Hur står sig budskapet om uppståndelsen inför en ärlig prövning av en sanningssökande skeptiker? I veckans avsnitt samtalar Per och Malin om de förunderliga händelserna i samband med Jesu död, med koppling till tv-dokumentärer, Pers detektivroman Sherlock: Fallet med den tomma graven, och naturligtvis allra främst: Bibelns vittnesbörd om den där unika påskhelgen i Jerusalem för 2000 år sedan.

programme.title: Bushpiloterna - Ett nytt liv - Del 3
programme.desc: I det tredje avsnittet av Bushpiloterna möter vi flyginstruktören Josef Moberg i Norge, som förbereder sig för att bli bushpilot för MAF. I Sydsudan följer vi Josefin, som ansvarar för driften av MAF-basen i Juba. I Papua Nya Guinea möter vi Jan Ivar och Linda Andresen som delar utmaningarna med att skapa en ny vardag långt hemifrån. Avsnittet handlar om förberedelser, ledarskap och vardagsliv i fält.

programme.title: Kyrkans människor - Navigatörerna

programme.title: Bushpiloterna - Nytt uppdrag - Del 4
programme.desc: I det fjärde avsnittet av Bush Pilots följer vi Eivind Lindtjørn och Mark Liprini i Tanzania, där en hektisk arbetsdag snart blir helt annorlunda än planerat. I Papua Nya Guinea förbereder sig den nya piloten Renee Brewer för ett uppdrag, tillsammans med den erfarna Glenys Watson – i områden där piratverksamhet är ett verkligt hot. Samtidigt flyger Jan Ivar Andresen och hans fru Linda tillbaka till en by han känner väl, för att besöka en amerikansk missionär och en lokal pastor. Efter en lång dag i luften väntar ett svårt budskap hemifrån Eivind.

programme.title: Föräldrapeppen - Förändring
programme.desc: Vi pratar med Andreas Frankner, pastor och missionär som bott i Ryssland i många år med sin familj. Hur är det att komma tillbaka till Sverige? Hur påverkas man av att bo utomlands under så många år? Kan man förändras? Måste man förändras?Enligt FN barnkonvention så har barn rätt till andlig utveckling. Tänker att det ligger i vårt föräldraansvar att samtala om vad vi tycker är meningen med livet – hur gör man det?Det blir även en del tankar om utanförskap när man inte längre har en gräsmatta. Finns det en klubb även för det?

programme.title: Mitt i veckan

programme.title: Världens historia
programme.desc: Det folkkära spelet har förgyllt många hemmakvällar runt om i världen. Men få vet att skapandet av Monopol kantas av girighet, besatthet och falskhet. Bakom tillkomsten hittar vi en radikal feminist, en grupp kväkare i Atlantic City, USA:s största spelbolag och en arbetslös ingenjör. Det är en berättelse om ohämmad makt och rikedom. Med en ensam vinnare på slutet.

programme.title: Djurvärldens vinnare
programme.desc: Det handlar om kattdjur, fåglar och apor - alla dessa är vinnare i djurvärlden. I denna serie tittar vi i tur och ordning på vad som gör just dessa arter speciella.

programme.title: Det hände här
programme.desc: I Njurunda i Medelpad hittar vi en sjöhäxa, ett olöst ufo-mysterium, och en kärleksberättelse där ett ungt par försöker trotsa havets krafter. Anders Lundin och tre historiker åker till små orter för att hitta stor historia.

programme.title: Resfeber: Turismens pris
programme.desc: I grunden har resor alltid drivits av motivationen att upptäcka nya platser, möta nya människor och uppleva nya kulturer. Så varför fokuserar så många destinationer idag på att erbjuda samma saker, samma upplevelser, samma utseende och känsla?

programme.title: Världens natur
programme.desc: David Attenborough presenterar en extrem värld, där djur kämpar för att överleva elementens krafter - och livet balanserar på en knivsegg.

programme.title: Så gjordes Planet Earth III
programme.desc: Följ med bakom kulisserna och ta del av vilket arbete som krävs för att skapa en av världens mest spektakulära naturserier.

programme.title: Den svarta svanen
programme.desc: En jurist, Amira, med kopplingar till stora delar av den danska undre världen beslutar sig för att bryta med sitt gamla liv. Hon blir mullvad för en grupp journalister som med hjälp av dold kamera kan avslöja allt från gängmedlemmar till advokater som kommer in till hennes kontor. Del 4 av 5: Det blir pressad stämning på Amiras kontor när medlemmar från rivaliserande gäng möts på kontoret.

programme.title: Historien om Sverige
programme.desc: Sverige är förvandlat till en militärstat, och den effektiva krigsapparaten väcker respekt i Europa. Men landet går också igenom enormt svåra tider med häxbränningar, missväxt och pest - och tusentals unga män kommer att dö i försöken att bevara stormakten.

programme.title: Historiskt eftersnack
programme.desc: Häxbål, missväxt och ständiga krig - kan det bli värre än det sena 1600-talet? Historikerna Anna Maria Forssberg och Martin Hårdstedt grottar i myten Karl XII och diskuterar snapphanar med journalisten och skåningen Louise Epstein. Programledare är Cecilia Düringer.

programme.title: Övergivna byggnader
programme.desc: I Panamas djungel byggdes en fästning för att skydda en amerikansk strategisk tillgång. I Italien, ett residens där en galen vetenskapsman en gång höll till. I Tyskland delar en spöklik järnväg en konfliktfylld stad mitt itu. Och bland Bulgariens berg - en fristad som gav hopp åt sina invånare.

programme.title: På resa med Bachstad: Japan
programme.desc: Hokkaido bjuder på ett språkligt geni till 82-åring. Øystein och Rune besöker öns ursprungsbefolkning och ett norskt vikingaskepp! Och Øystein testar Japans allra billigaste tält.

programme.title: Att bli orangutang
programme.desc: Deras bakgrund skiljer sig men nu ska de tillsammans få gå igenom en mångårig utbildning. Den ska göra dem rustade att leva som fria orangutanger i regnskogen.

programme.title: Vilda Korea
programme.desc: Koreas livsfarliga gräns - där norr möter söder - är en smal landremsa som i 65 år varit isolerad från världen. Nu är den koreanska demilitariserade zonen en av de vildaste och mest orörda livsmiljöerna för vilda djur i Asien.

programme.title: Ett enklare liv
programme.desc: Ben reser till amerikanska Kaskadbergen där han träffar brittiskfödda Lynx. Hon har levt mer än halva sitt liv i skogen och är övertygad om att ett enklare liv är något vi alla bör anamma. Ben får lära sig stenålderstricken som krävs för att överleva i det vilda.

programme.title: Världens historia
programme.desc: Knut kontrollerar halva England, men krigarkungen Edmund Järnsida samlar motståndet. London belägras och ett stort förräderi får avgörande betydelse. Knut försöker säkra makten med våld och ett taktiskt giftermål.

programme.title: Antikens riken
programme.desc: I en värld där fiender letar efter svaghet, måste våra forntida makter använda all sin styrka och list för att försvara sitt folk och erövra nya marker. Vilka kommer att klara utmaningen på slagfältet?

programme.title: Kungliga skandaler
programme.desc: Suzannah upptäcker äktenskapsskandalen som satte en kunglig person i vittnesbåset, utforskar vad som gjorde Karl II till den glada monarken och avslöjar en sexskandal som involverade en bordell och en kunglig prins. Från medeltiden och fram till våra dagar har det brittiska kungahuset varit föremål för allehanda skandaler. Professor Suzannah Lipscomb undersöker kungliga skandaler genom tiderna.

programme.title: Djurvärldens vinnare
programme.desc: Det handlar om kattdjur, fåglar och apor - alla dessa är vinnare i djurvärlden. I denna serie tittar vi i tur och ordning på vad som gör just dessa arter speciella.

programme.title: Mellankrigstidens drömmar
programme.desc: Del 2 av 8: Freden. En serie om mellankrigstiden baserad på sanna berättelser från livet i en tid full av hopp och förtvivlan. Här följer vi ett antal människors livsöden, via deras autentiska dagböcker, brev och minnen.

programme.title: Latela - Lauri ja superautot
programme.desc: Dodge Viper on ollut lapsesta asti Latelle The Auto. Innostusta onkin vaikea pitää aisoissa, kun Vuorisen Tommi ajaa Viperinsa näytille. Perinpohjaisen ihmettelyn ja ihailun sekaisissa fiiliksissä Lauri pääsee vielä auton rattiinkin, joten hymy on herkässä paluumatkalla Latelaan. Kalkussa äijät odottelevatkin jo tv:n ääressä ja katseluun valitaan Garage Kings.

programme.title: Amerikan rajavartijat: Meksiko
programme.desc: Yli puolet USA:n etelärajasta, Teksasin ja Meksikon välillä, muodostuu Rio Grandesta, jonka silloilla kuljetaan sekä laillisesti että laittomasti.

programme.title: Miten kaikki tehdään?
programme.desc: Nykymaailma on täynnä monimutkaisia tuotanto- ja valmistusprosesseja. Nopeatahtisessa sarjassa avataan eri alojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa, miten kaikki oikein tehdään.

programme.title: The life I love - The pianist Menahem Pressler
programme.desc: The music world has known Menahem Pressler for more than half a century and mainly for his work with the famous Beaux Arts Trio. He was the heart of this ensemble and when in 2008 the trio decided to separate, it was not the end for Menahem Pressler’s career – in fact it was the start of a most remarkable and successful path as a soloist and in 2013, the 90-year-old grand seigneur of the piano gave his long overdue debut with the Berliner Philharmoniker. In ‘The life I love – the pianist Menahem Pressler’, from talks with Pressler over excerpts from one of his Master Classes, to interviews with artists like Daniel Harding, Quatuor Ébène, Leonidas Kavakos or Daniel Hope, we will gain deep insights into the life of this enchantingly “venerable prodigy”. Menahem Pressler died on May 6, 2023Subtitles available for this program with your remote control

programme.title: Made in...
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Transporter, affectionally called VW Bulli, has been built in Hannover-Stöcken since 1956. Since opening in 2004, the number of produced cars has almost been doubled to 60 units a day.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The World Rallycross Championship is a crowd-puller. When famous drivers like Ken Block, Petter Solberg or Sebastien Loeb fight for the victory, everybody wants to be present. No other racing event grows faster than the Rallycross Championship, even though things can get quite rough, because jumps and full contacts are allowed and wanted. Especially when Ken Block starts, the crowd becomes crazy. Thanks to his spectacular 'Gymkhana' drifting videos he became an absolute superstar of the scene. Wherever he shows up, tires are smoking.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Silver Arrows stand for an unparalleled era of motorsports. They dominated the racing scene in the 1930s like no other. Rudolf Carraciola, Hermann Lang, Juan Manuel Fangio and StirlingMoss are the heroes of that time and became legendary thanks to the Silver Arrows. Car History details the unique history of the Silver Arrows using both original footage and interviews with motorsport experts.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Auto Union is the incredible story of the 'Fantastic Four': Horch, Audi, DKW and Wanderer. With the sign of the four rings, they are the second-largest automotive group in Germany behind Opel in the 1930s. The four brands of Auto Union are automobile pacemakers, build technical milestones and the fastest car in the world. Today, the name is long gone, but the brand lives on.

programme.title: MotorStories
programme.desc: Kati and Patrick from Munich are huge fanas of US cars and proud owners of a 1972 Chevrolet Chevelle. But they are no longer satisfied with its 5.7-liter small block and want to buy a bigger engine. For that reason they're visiting the engine specialists from Down Town Garage, who store more than 50 engines - from powerful stroker to rare flathead engines. Part of the location is also an American diner with a motel. There you can spend the night in proper style, for example in the Garage Room with its own V8 table. But before the Chevelle can get a more powerful engine, the periphery items must be updated, which means that the front axis is modified. A sportier kit with new wishbones, damper

programme.title: UIM F1H2O World Powerboat Championship 2025
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: NZ Jetsprint Championship 2025
programme.desc: The New Zealand Jetsprint Championship is the most important sprint boat competition from New Zealand, the country where the sport was founded in 1981. Jetsprinting is comparable to rally sports, but there is only one boat on the track at any given time and boats drive at very high speeds. The up to 500 HP strong jet sprint boats therefore try to achieve the best time on the tracks.

At the airfield in Werneuchen high performance cars battle it out in a quarter mile race. Is Frank able to defy the competition with his 700hp racer?

programme.title: Motorheads

programme.title: Car History

programme.title: Pikes Peak International Hillclimb 2025
programme.desc: The legendary Pikes Peak International Hillclimb returns to the 156-turn, 12.42-mile mountain course known as The Race to the Clouds. Drivers battle against gravity, thin air and unforgiving terrain as they push their machines to the absolute limit in one of the most spectacular and dangerous motorsport events in the world.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In the dusty winding road in the Andes Mountains the rallye was based on the city of cordoba. Spectators whether on horseback or on foot thrown into the 23 stages over 3 days.

programme.title: Motorheads

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Auto Union is the incredible story of the 'Fantastic Four': Horch, Audi, DKW and Wanderer. With the sign of the four rings, they are the second-largest automotive group in Germany behind Opel in the 1930s. The four brands of Auto Union are automobile pacemakers, build technical milestones and the fastest car in the world. Today, the name is long gone, but the brand lives on.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The World Rallycross Championship is a crowd-puller. When famous drivers like Ken Block, Petter Solberg or Sebastien Loeb fight for the victory, everybody wants to be present. No other racing event grows faster than the Rallycross Championship, even though things can get quite rough, because jumps and full contacts are allowed and wanted. Especially when Ken Block starts, the crowd becomes crazy. Thanks to his spectacular 'Gymkhana' drifting videos he became an absolute superstar of the scene. Wherever he shows up, tires are smoking.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Silver Arrows stand for an unparalleled era of motorsports. They dominated the racing scene in the 1930s like no other. Rudolf Carraciola, Hermann Lang, Juan Manuel Fangio and StirlingMoss are the heroes of that time and became legendary thanks to the Silver Arrows. Car History details the unique history of the Silver Arrows using both original footage and interviews with motorsport experts.

programme.title: MotorStories
programme.desc: Which is the American car of the 60s? Which is the symbol for the American art of car manufacturing? For many people it's either the Corvette or the Ford Mustang. During his search for these American dream cars of the 60s Tillmann Miritz makes a surprise discovery in Florida (Ford Mustang 1964).

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad 2024
programme.desc: The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles. Nearly vertical cliffs have to be climbed, demanding time challenges have to be solved or spectacular aquaplaning stunts have to be performed.

programme.title: FIM X-Trial World Championship 2026
programme.desc: The FIM X-Trial World Championship is an international indoor motorcycle trials championship that features some of the best riders in the world competing in highly technical and challenging obstacle courses. In X-Trial events, riders navigate through a series of sections that include obstacles such as rocks, logs, and other challenging terrain, aiming to complete the course with the fewest penalties.

programme.title: FIM Enduro World Championship 2026
programme.desc: The FIM EnduroGP World Championship delivers thrilling off-road action, with top riders battling on challenging courses with natural obstacles. A packed schedule showcases skill and excitement.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World and European Championship 2026
programme.desc: The FIM Supermoto World Championship, also known as S1GP, is the premier international competition for Supermoto racing, first held in 2002. programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Syväsukelluksella Australian meriin Phil Breslin etsii vedenalaista maailmaa hallitsevia villejä olentoja. Ensin hän törmää pahamaineiseen metsästäjään, joka on rakennettu kuin torpedo ja aseistettu tikareilla - tiikerihaiin. Seuraavaksi Phil sukeltaa sirojen mantarauskujen kanssa, ja yksi planeetan suurimmista olennoista, majesteettinen ryhävalas, laulaa hänelle serenadin.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin lähtee Australian mantereelta etsimään saarilla asuvia eläimiä, jotka ovat sopeutuneet selviytymään ankarassa eristyksessä. Wellesleyn saarilla Phil kohtaa munivan vihreän merikilpikonnan. Myöhemmin hän jäljittää metsästävän dingolauman ja törmää kunnioitettavaan käärmeeseen, jolla on pelottava nimi - kuolemankäärme.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin lähtee Australian savannille etsimään maan pelottavimpia olentoja. Ensin hän tapaa Australian suurimman petolinnun, kiilapyrstökotkan, ja Australian aggressiivisimman käärmeen, rannikkotaipaanin. Myöhemmin hän näkee kaulusliskon ja sen kiehtovat puolustusmekanismit.

programme.title: Etelä-Afrikka: Äärimmäisyyksien maa
programme.desc: Etelä-Afrikan eläimet ovat kehittyneet selviytyäkseen toistensa kynsistä. Etelä-Afrikassa paine selviytyä tuottaa eksoottisia lajeja, joihin lukeutuvat niin tavallisten lajien jättiläis- ja pygmiversiot, jotka ovat vallanneet aivan tietyn alueen.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Alkuperäiskansalainen ja kouluttaja Phil Breslin lähtee Australian pahamaineiselle suomaalle tapaamaan ainutlaatuisia eläimiä, jotka on luotu selviytymään tässä kosteassa ympäristössä, jonne vain harvat ihmiset matkustavat. Phil kohtaa Australian ainutlaatuisen makean veden krokotiilin, kiehtovan barramundin ja yhden maailman vaarallisimmista eläimistä, suolaisen veden krokotiilin.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin vaeltaa Australian rannikon karuilla kallioilla ja hiekkatasanteilla löytääkseen eläimet, jotka hallitsevat rantaviivan raakoja elementtejä. Phil kohtaa ensin taivaan mestarin, valkomerikotkan, jonka äärimmäisen terävät kynnet tekevät siitä ammattimaisen tappajan. Seuraavaksi hän törmää maailman myrkyllisimpään kalaan ja pahamaineiseen rauskuun.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin suuntaa syvälle Australian mangrovemetsiin ja etsii merkittäviä eläimiä, jotka on rakennettu elämään suolla. Phil kahlaa mudan ja lian läpi ja tapaa ärhäkän mutaravun, jolla on tappavat pihdit, ennen kuin hän nappaa paljain käsin rauskun. Kaiken aikaa Philin seurana on yksi maailman vihatuimmista otuksista - hyttynen.

Ensin hän törmää pahamaineiseen metsästäjään, joka on rakennettu kuin torpedo ja aseistettu tikareilla - tiikerihaiin. Seuraavaksi Phil sukeltaa sirojen mantarauskujen kanssa, ja yksi planeetan suurimmista olennoista, majesteettinen ryhävalas, laulaa hänelle serenadin.

Wellesleyn saarilla Phil kohtaa munivan vihreän merikilpikonnan. Myöhemmin hän jäljittää metsästävän dingolauman ja törmää kunnioitettavaan käärmeeseen, jolla on pelottava nimi - kuolemankäärme.

programme.title: Iberian metsät
programme.desc: Kilvoittelu määrittää kaikkea elämää Iberian niemimaan metsissä. Kesän saapumisen myötä alueella alkaa pitkä kuivuuskausi, joka tekee eloonjäännistä vielä vaikeampaa siellä asustaville eläimille. Jokainen yksilö joutuu taistelemaan saadakseen osansa rajallisista resursseista – ja se tekee kilpailusta sekä lajien sisällä että niiden välillä väistämätöntä.

programme.title: Afrikan jokien titaanit
programme.desc: Afrikan mahtavat joet ovat koti monille erilaisille mahtaville asukkaille, kuten norsuille ja virtahevoille, jotka syövät ja juovat siellä, missä krokotiilit metsästävät ja lisääntyvät. Me paljastamme, miten nämä massiiviset eläimet jakavat vesistöt vastahakoisesti muiden pienempien olentojen, kuten piikkisikojen, gasellikotkien ja leopardien, kanssa.

programme.title: Valtamerien jäiset saaret
programme.desc: Eteläisellä Atlantilla ja Intian valtamerellä Etelä-Georgian, Bouvet'n, Marionin ja Crozetin saarilla elää joitain maailman suurimmista hylje- ja pingviinikannoista. Nämä olennot ovat sopeutuneet elämään jäätävässä meressä erinomaisesti, mutta niiden on tultava maihin lisääntymään. Niitä seuraavat saalistajat - tappajavalaat.

programme.title: Venom Files - Anatomy of a Snake Bite
programme.desc: Käärmeet purevat vuosittain miljoonia ihmisiä, mutta niiden myrkky on kehittynyt metsästystä, ei ihmisten vahingoittamista varten. Tutustu kuningaskobran, mustamamban, aavikkotaipaanin, puffadderin, pyramidikyyn, Mosambikin sylkijäkobran ja pelottavan puukäärmeen kiehtoviin ja tappaviin sopeutumistapoihin. Matkusta Intian vilkkaista kylistä Afrikan villeille savanneille ja Australian erämaahan todistaaksesi, kuinka myrkky lamauttaa, sulattaa ja suojaa. Tutustu siihen, miksi jokainen käärmeenpurema on erilainen – ja kuinka maailmamme törmäävät yllättävillä tavoilla. Jokaisen käärmeen myrkky kertoo tarinan metsästyksestä, puolustuksesta ja selviytymisestä. Mutta kun ihmiset ja käärmeet kohtaavat, kemia, joka kerran piti yllä tasapainoa, tuo nyt mukanaan katastrofin. Venom Files paljastaa luonnon tappavimmat salamurhaajat.

programme.title: Turvatarkastus: Ensimmäinen luokka Etelä-Amerikassa
programme.desc: Liittovaltion poliisi törmää moniin salakuljetustapoihin Perun pääkaupungin Liman Jorge Chavez -lentoasemalla ja Brasilian São Paulo-Guarulhos -lentoasemalla. Vastanaineilla on epäilyttävät asut. Ensimmäisen luokan matkustaja kantaa laukkua, joka vaikuttaa olevan osittain valmistettu kokaiinista. Poliisit pidättävät miehen, jolla on tavaroissaan huumeita ja joka saattaa piilotella lisää muualla.

programme.title: Tucci makumatkalla Italiassa
programme.desc: Marchen alue sijaitsee Italiassa Adrianmeren rannikolla, ja vaikka kansainväliset turistit eivät tunne aluetta kovinkaan hyvin, Stanley kaivaa esiin tunnustusta ansaitsevia kulinaarisia aarteita. Hän kokeilee pulleita käsin pyydettyjä simpukoita, jotka tarjoillaan yllättävällä reseptillä, ja löytää kolmen Michelin-tähden ruokaa rantamökistä. Hän maistaa myös vincisgrassia, lasagnea muistuttavaa, mutta paikallisten mielestä paljon parempaa ruokaa, joka on peräisin yhdestä varhaisimmista keittokirjoista.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: A Surfing Life: David Van Zyl
programme.desc: David Van Zyl is a young South-African surfer that is quickly gaining popularity and becoming a rising star on the pro-surfer scene. For surf connoisseurs, his name has made history in 2019 as the first International Surfer to ever win the Vans Pro competition in Hawaii. Before then, Hawaiian surfers had an undefeated upper hand that was finally overcome by this young underdog. He now faces new challenges to engrave his name in fame.Get ready to catch some South African waves with David Van Zyl and find out more about his lifestyle on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: RORC Caribbean 600
programme.desc: The RORC Caribbean 600 is an exciting 600-mile offshore race that takes competitors around some of the most beautiful islands of the Caribbean. In its 12th edition, more than 73 boats from 22 countries joined in a competition with participants from over 37 different nationalities.The fleet is made up not only of professional sailors and their boats, but also with Corinthian amateurs that love this offshore race. As it is the only offshore race in the Caribbean, it gets the attention of the best sailors worldwide. The race starts and finishes in Antigua and weaves its way around 11 different islands including St. Maarten and Guadaloupe amongst them.Be part of this unique race across the Caribbean with Nautical Channel and find out what crew will raise with victory.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The International Canoe Federation (ICF) is the world governing body responsible for administering the sport of Canoeing, which includes both canoeing and kayaking. Governing eight disciplines, two of which are Olympic sports (Canoe Sprint and Canoe Slalom); the ICF delights us with competitions for these sports.While canoe slalom is a timed event where competitors navigate a whitewater course by passing through a combination of upstream and downstream gates, canoe sprint is a race to the line on a flatwater course. Both present a challenge for which athletes spend months, if not years, preparing for.Watch this extreme water sport and the two disciplines that take place in the Olympics: sprints and slalom.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The Sprint World Cup from the International Canoe Federation starts in Szeged, in the south of Hungary. This is the first Sprint World Cup of the 2018 season, and 700 athletes from 62 nations have been battling it out for the top spot. Who will raise to the top as the best nation in the sport? Find out on the highlights of the 2018 Sprint World Cup 1 Szeged.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: The GC32 Racing Tour is an international competition that allows regular sailors, both pros and keen amateurs, to get a taste of state of the art, flying, foil-born yacht racing at 30+ knot speeds. This competition offers thrilling emotions as pioneered in the America’s Cup, but at a fraction of the cost.Teams compete on a five-event circuit, mostly across Southern Europe, with the aim of raising with victory in the competition. Sailing across destinations as Oman, Riva del Garda, Lagos or Villasimius, the Speed Catamarans of GC32 Racing Tour propose exciting challenges to international teams.Follow the competition now to find out the fastest Catamarans on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: Today we are taking you to the hidden gems of the Croatian coast. Places of mesmerising beauty but known by few. We are talking about Rogoznica and Primošten! We'll explore the Kornati islands, the destination that amazed the famous writer George Bernard Shaw and much more.

programme.title: Sail-Ho
programme.desc: We will visit the beautiful historical city of Šibenik, explore fascinating Šibenik channel and the Krka river, learn a bit about unique coral handmade jewelry, visit a very interesting museum on the island of Prvić and much more!

This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: A Surfing Life: David Van Zyl
programme.desc: David Van Zyl is a young South-African surfer that is quickly gaining popularity and becoming a rising star on the pro-surfer scene. For surf connoisseurs, his name has made history in 2019 as the first International Surfer to ever win the Vans Pro competition in Hawaii. Before then, Hawaiian surfers had an undefeated upper hand that was finally overcome by this young underdog. He now faces new challenges to engrave his name in fame.Get ready to catch some South African waves with David Van Zyl and find out more about his lifestyle on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters
programme.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: MAR
programme.desc: Surfing has ceased a long time ago to be considered a niche sport. As the mainstream industry discovers its potential for selling clothes, trips and a whole set of ‘lifestyle’ products, there are those who appreciate it for what it is in its purest form – a direct connection to mother nature.We accompany Big Wave surfer Alex Botelho and some of his friends to meet surfers who balance their love for the ocean and nature with a professional career in the sport. Mar is a tale of discovery, triumph and (almost) tragedy, but above all it is a life affirming pledge to positive vibes in and out of the line-up.Get ready to soak up a new conception of the world of surf as Alex Botelho unveils concepts unknown for the mainstream audience, available on Nautical Channel.Awards:Best Feature Documentary – Best Istanbul Film Festival 2021. Official Selections 2021: Ocean Film Festival World Tour, International Ocean Film Festival.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: The GC32 Racing Tour is an international competition that allows regular sailors, both pros and keen amateurs, to get a taste of state of the art, flying, foil-born yacht racing at 30+ knot speeds. This competition offers thrilling emotions as pioneered in the America’s Cup, but at a fraction of the cost.Teams compete on a five-event circuit, mostly across Southern Europe, with the aim of raising with victory in the competition. Sailing across destinations as Oman, Riva del Garda, Lagos or Villasimius, the Speed Catamarans of GC32 Racing Tour propose exciting challenges to international teams.Follow the competition now to find out the fastest Catamarans on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

programme.title: Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Join us on a journey through one of the most welcoming island of the Caribbean, Guadeloupe! Explore its natural habitats rich in colour and rhythmic sounds that hypnotize us in this dreamy destination.Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe takes us on a journey in the world of art as we meet a local artist whose art shines light on our modern habits. Discover this hub for scuba divers as you swim through Cousteau's underwater reserve, a breath-taking spot for all those who love diving into the clear blue waters of the Caribbean.Finally, come dance to the drumbeats of a Caribbean jam whilst allowing the contagious energy to move you. Not many islands lend themselves as well as Guadeloupe! Be sure not to miss our exciting excavation through this unforgettable island on the Golden Strokes of Guadeloupe, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: RORC Caribbean 600
programme.desc: The RORC Caribbean 600 is an exciting 600-mile offshore race that takes competitors around some of the most beautiful islands of the Caribbean. In its 12th edition, more than 73 boats from 22 countries joined in a competition with participants from over 37 different nationalities.The fleet is made up not only of professional sailors and their boats, but also with Corinthian amateurs that love this offshore race. As it is the only offshore race in the Caribbean, it gets the attention of the best sailors worldwide. The race starts and finishes in Antigua and weaves its way around 11 different islands including St. Maarten and Guadaloupe amongst them.Be part of this unique race across the Caribbean with Nautical Channel and find out what crew will raise with victory.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The International Canoe Federation (ICF) is the world governing body responsible for administering the sport of Canoeing, which includes both canoeing and kayaking. Governing eight disciplines, two of which are Olympic sports (Canoe Sprint and Canoe Slalom); the ICF delights us with competitions for these sports.While canoe slalom is a timed event where competitors navigate a whitewater course by passing through a combination of upstream and downstream gates, canoe sprint is a race to the line on a flatwater course. Both present a challenge for which athletes spend months, if not years, preparing for.Watch this extreme water sport and the two disciplines that take place in the Olympics: sprints and slalom.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The Sprint World Cup from the International Canoe Federation starts in Szeged, in the south of Hungary. This is the first Sprint World Cup of the 2018 season, and 700 athletes from 62 nations have been battling it out for the top spot. Who will raise to the top as the best nation in the sport? Find out on the highlights of the 2018 Sprint World Cup 1 Szeged.

programme.title: Ride to the Roots
programme.desc: When you have the competition in your blood, there is never an end. You keep looking for more, for the adrenaline rush that comes with it and everyday you thrive to improve yourself. This is the mindset of Adriano de Souza, our protagonist in this episode of Ride to the Roots. He goes back to the favelas he grew up in. Will the happiness of reliving his childhood make him change his career path, or will it be a bigger motivation?

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32
programme.desc: The GC32 Racing Tour is an international competition that allows regular sailors, both pros and keen amateurs, to get a taste of state of the art, flying, foil-born yacht racing at 30+ knot speeds. This competition offers thrilling emotions as pioneered in the America’s Cup, but at a fraction of the cost.Teams compete on a five-event circuit, mostly across Southern Europe, with the aim of raising with victory in the competition. Sailing across destinations as Oman, Riva del Garda, Lagos or Villasimius, the Speed Catamarans of GC32 Racing Tour propose exciting challenges to international teams.Follow the competition now to find out the fastest Catamarans on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Les Voiles de Saint Tropez
programme.desc: Marking the end of the Mediterranean yachting season, Les Voiles de Saint Tropez will be back for its 20th edition. Close to 4,000 sailors and more than 300 sailing yachts will gather in St Tropez in early autumn for an action-packed programme of competitive racing and lively social events.

programme.title: Wind Masters
programme.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programme.title: A Surfing Life: David Van Zyl
programme.desc: David Van Zyl is a young South-African surfer that is quickly gaining popularity and becoming a rising star on the pro-surfer scene. For surf connoisseurs, his name has made history in 2019 as the first International Surfer to ever win the Vans Pro competition in Hawaii. Before then, Hawaiian surfers had an undefeated upper hand that was finally overcome by this young underdog. He now faces new challenges to engrave his name in fame.Get ready to catch some South African waves with David Van Zyl and find out more about his lifestyle on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: The Dangerous Waters crewmembers will ride an epic adventure like no other on their JetSki. Their world-first adventure is plagued with wildlife, wicked waters, tropical storms and new unknown challenges they will have to overcome. As the conditions worsen, crewmembers are forced to drastically take decisions in an environment where not all will get to their final destination.Become part of the crew as they battle the elements on their JetSkis, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programme.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programme.title: Jet Ski World Series
programme.desc: Put your helmets on because we are getting started with the Jet Ski World Series! Delivering whooping speeds of 100km/hr in under 3.8 seconds and with 500 horsepower, riders need to be sharp to turn 30 degrees at 140 km/h, putting the 'Jet' in Jet Ski. Wearing no protective body, grappling with the waves and fighting out with gravity, the riders that dare challenge this competition are some of the most corageous athletes in the world. Are you going to miss out? Tune up to the latest edition of the Jet Ski World Series!

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programme.desc: The International Canoe Federation (ICF) is the world governing body responsible for administering the sport of Canoeing, which includes both canoeing and kayaking. Governing eight disciplines, two of which are Olympic sports (Canoe Sprint and Canoe Slalom); the ICF delights us with competitions for these sports.While canoe slalom is a timed event where competitors navigate a whitewater course by passing through a combination of upstream and downstream gates, canoe sprint is a race to the line on a flatwater course. Both present a challenge for which athletes spend months, if not years, preparing for.Watch this extreme water sport and the two disciplines that take place in the Olympics: sprints and slalom.

programme.desc: Tuolilla istuen lisätään lihasten venyvyyttä keskittyen alaraajojen ja yläraajojen lihaksiin.

programme.title: Kädet aivoja aktivoimassa
programme.desc: Tiesitkö, että käsien ja huulien alue on vahvasti edustettuna aivokuorella? Käsien ja huulien yhdistelmäliikkeet aktivoivat aivoja tehokkaasti. Aistit ovat portti muistoihin ja eri aistien käyttötukee aivojen toimintaa. Tässä jaksossa aktivoimme aivoja käsien, suun alueen ja aistien kautta. Tervetuloa mukaan. Harjoitukset sopivat kaikille katsojille.

programme.title: Alaraajojen voima
programme.desc: Jalkamme kantavat meitä joka paikkaan. Tämän vuoksi onkin erittäin tärkeää ylläpitää niiden toimintakykyä, sekä kehittää jaloissa olevien lihasten voimaa. Harjoituksessa keskitytään juuri jalkojen isojen lihasryhmien aktivointiin sekä lihasten voiman kehittämiseen. Harjoitus on tehty ensisijaisesti seisoen toteutettavaksi, mutta voit liittyä mukaan myös istuen muokkaamalla liikkeitä tähän tyyliin toteutettaviksi.

programme.title: Luentotuokio - Ikääntyneen ravitsemus
programme.desc: Pohditaan ikäihmisen hyvää ravitsemusta ja sen peruspilareita. Miten tämä hyvä ravitsemus on yhteydessä hyvään elämänlaatuun ja toimintakykyyn? Ikääntyessä toimintakyky muuttuu, minkä vuoksi on tärkeää tukea omaa elämää hyvällä ja oikeaoppisella ravinnolla.

programme.title: Hengähdyshetki – Hetkeen rauhoittuminen
programme.desc: Saanan kanssa rentoudutaan juuri siihen hetkeen, missä tällä hetkellä olet. Hengittämällä rauhassa saadaan hermosto rauhoittumaan arjen keskellä. Kuuntele kehoasi ja päästä irti kellolla mitattavasta ajasta. Mennyttä ja tulevaa ei tarvitse miettiä. Huomioidaan ja tiedostetaan tuntemuksia eri puolin kehoa ja annetaan kehonosille lisähuomiota. Keho ja mieli toimivat yhdessä, joten kehoa rauhoittamalla myös mielesi saattaa päästä rentoutuneeseen tilaan. Ota mukava asento ja tule tunnustelemaan omia tuntemuksiasi.

programme.title: Voimisteluvartti - Tanssi
programme.desc: Kerttu ja Anu ohjaavat tanssillisen jumpan, joka on mahdollista toteuttaa seisten tai istuen. Käydään läpi eri tanssilajeja ja annetaan rytmin viedä kehoa. Tanssiminen vie mukanaan ja liikkumisesta tulee entistä hauskempaa, jolloin liikunta tapahtuu huomaamatta. Tanssi parantaa kuntoa ja koordinaatiota.

programme.title: Koordinaatio ja istumatasapaino
programme.desc: Koordinaation sekä istumatasapainon kehittäminen matalan kynnyksen liikkeillä. Tuokiossa käännetään katsetta eri suuntiin, tehdään painonsiirtoa istuen, sekä kehitetään koordinaatiota käsien ja jalkojen aivoja virkistävillä harjoitteilla.

programme.title: Laiva on lastattu aivopähkinöillä
programme.desc: Pohditaan yhdessä erilaisia keinoja, miten voi virkistää ajattelua ja tehdä aivojumppaa. Pelataan Laiva on lastattu -peliä. Esiintyjät: geronomiopiskelija Eija Marttila sosionomiopiskelija Sakari Rantala Eläkeläiset Aulikki Järvi ja Rae-Marja Vataja lehtori Hanna Raitakari

programme.title: Seisomafysio - Hyvinvointia selälle
programme.desc: Nyt hoidetaan selkää kuntoon liikkumisen avulla. Harjoituksessa keskitytään selän alueeseen. Tavoitteena on vetreyttää selkää, lisätä sen liikkuvuutta, sekä parantaa tukilihasten toimintaa selän ja keskivartalon alueella. Harjoitukset on laadittu ensisijaisesti seisoen tehtäviksi, mutta pystyt osallistumaan myös istuma-asennossa.

programme.title: Kehon hahmottaminen
programme.desc: Kehon hahmottaminen on yksi liikkumisen peruspilareista. Liike ja kosketus aktivoivat aivoja, ja aivot ovat kehomme ohjausyksikkö. Tässä jaksossa harjoittamme kehon hahmotusta tunnustellen ja kehon eri osia nimeämällä. Harjoitteet onnistuvat parhaiten pariharjoitteena, mutta voit hyvin tehdä ne myös yksin. Tervetuloa mukaan. Harjoitteet sopivat kaikille katsojille.

programme.title: Kirkkopuistossa Soi – Kristoffer Streng
programme.desc: Kirkkopuistossa Soi on vuodesta 1995 järjestetty hengellisen musiikin tapahtuma. Astu mukaan tapahtumaan ja laula kanssamme tuttuja hengellisiä lauluja ja kuuntele esityksiä. Ohjelmassa esiintyy Kristoffer Streng.?Jaksossa esitetään laulut Hallelu et Adonai (Ylistäkää Jumalaa), Siunattu olkoon hän, Hän suuri on Messiaamme, Ylitse kaiken, Vain yksin Jeesus ja Armolaulu.?

programme.title: Vaativa kehonhuolto
programme.desc: Vaativan kehonhuollon kanssanne tekee Kuntoa Kansalle -ohjaaja Henriikka

programme.title: Reazione a catena
programme.desc: Il gioco che, utilizzando l'associazione logica di parole, mette alla prova la padronanza della lingua italiana di concorrenti e telespettatori. Due squadre composte da 3 giocatori si sfidano sulla loro capacità di indovinare, formare, completare e ordinare parole e catene di vocaboli.

programme.title: Il restauratore
programme.desc: Questa volta Basilio si ritrova a dover indagare in ambito universitario, nel mondo degli scavi archeologici. Toccando una statua di marmo policromo, il restauratore vede una giovane aggredita da un uomo e il corpo di una donna senza più vita, in prossimità di uno scavo. Quello che apparentemente sembra un delitto passionale, nasconde in realtà una storia di prevaricazione e invidie.

programme.title: Il restauratore
programme.desc: Siamo alla resa dei conti: Emma, indagando sull'assassino del marito, ha attirato su di sé i sospetti di Nadia, la escort che sembra a conoscenza di come andarono realmente i fatti. Basilio nel frattempo ha scoperto che anche Magrini, il precedente restauratore, aveva il dono. Toccando proprio il bauletto di Emma, Basilio vede la donna prima sul punto di uccidere Magrini, quindi imbavagliata e legata a una sedia. Basilio interviene per tentare di salvare l'amica.
